producer_report.summary: Before the candidate is built, Athena now compares the producer's change list with the accepted plan's files and the reading's deliverables. A listed file that is not changed, and that the report does not explain, is sent back in the existing single send-back. If it is still unexplained afterwards, it is passed to the verifier as one of the producer-report gaps. Root cause: nothing compared the candidate with the plan before verification, so the verifier found the missing test files only at the end. Changes: (1) `ProducerOutput` gains `unchanged_planned_files` (path and reason each), with `#[serde(default)]`, so old fixtures still parse; the schema still requires it. (2) `crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs` gains `planned_paths` and `unchanged_planned_files` plus a three-argument `send_back_text` that names each path. The loop calls them after each producer attempt and shares the send-back with unmet criteria. A run with no change at all is skipped, because it already fails as an idle producer. (3) The producer brief gets a "Planned files left unchanged" section. (4) Tests in `run_pin_tests.rs`. (5) CHANGELOG and `docs/design/job-planning.md`. (6) Two test-support changes the check forced: the fake producer in `fake.rs` and the CLI test harness in `tests/common/mod.rs` now explain the listed files they do not edit. Without this, every change reading's auto-added CHANGELOG.md deliverable sent about 14 existing job_plan, lifecycle and retry tests back. The missed time target is untouched.

open_issues: The reasons the producer gives in unchanged_planned_files are not saved: the ProducerReport record in athena-data has no field for them. Saving them would need a record schema change, which I did not make.

I edited crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs, which are not in the expected deliverables. Both were needed to keep the existing CLI tests passing once the check existed.
I did not edit the shared producer.md prompt files (athena-context, cap-change, cap-study); the prompt text is in the producer brief instead, because those prompt frames have token budgets.
A planned file that is changed, but not in the way the plan intended (for example a planned test file touched only by whitespace), is not flagged; the check compares paths only.
mistakes: My first full athena-cli run failed 14 tests in job_plan, lifecycle and retry: I had not anticipated that every change reading's auto-added CHANGELOG.md deliverable would trip the check in the scripted test harnesses. Fixed in fake.rs and tests/common/mod.rs, and the full suite then passed.
learnings: Every change reading gets CHANGELOG.md added to its deliverables (ensure_changelog in reading.rs), so any producer that does not touch it is now flagged unless it explains it.

Test harnesses that script producer reports (fake.rs deterministic_turn and crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs Scenario::script) must fill unchanged_planned_files, or the new send-back adds a producer invocation and breaks the invocation-order assertions in job_plan, lifecycle and retry.
Schema hardening (harden in outputs.rs) marks every property required, even with #[serde(default)]. The model must always emit the new field, while old JSON fixtures without it still parse.
The producer report record (athena-data ProducerReport) and redact_report do not carry the new field, so the stated reasons are not kept in the invocation record.
desires: A way to read the full output of a long cargo test run inside the working directory; it was saved outside it and the file reader was refused.
